boundaries.tracking: decode + shared measured-motion session + actual adaptive FP + CUDA sync; session evidence included, final output serialization excluded; current-frame continuity decision and publication evidence included
boundaries.initialization: mesh/frame loading + first-frame mask/click + FP setup + complete candidate registration/assessment + current-input GFTT and tentative measured session startup + evidence serialization; no trusted-memory initialization + continuity decision and publication evidence

interpretation: Parent preflight, supervised child and postflight are sequential; other_parent_overhead is their residual to total wall time.
Pipeline wall, serial stages and application sub-stages are nested, use different boundaries, and must not be summed across levels.
The existing-mesh branch did not separately record full tracking-child stage wall time: null means unavailable, not zero.
Tracking samples include 29 post-initialization inputs; initialization includes registration and admission, so these are not additive.
Child budget excludes parent inventory hashing. Existing-mesh and generated-mesh supervised budgets were 600 and 1200 seconds, respectively.
Pipeline wall starts after its initial checkpoint validation; supervised child time also covers interpreter/import/early validation and final process completion.
Different input sequences, initialization masks, candidate counts and fresh environment/cache contexts prevent a cross-case speed claim.
